CONART ENGINEERS

We create the assets and infrastructure that make India stronger

Let's connect

Services Construction

Civil & MEP Construction

Conart delivers reliable at-risk general contracting services, backed by over four decades of experience. Our clients trust us for our responsiveness and commitment to exceptional service.

EPC / Design Build

The design-build process is one that can potentially bring great value to an owner – so long as it is done right. Fortunately, Conart is one of the country’s most experienced design-build contractors.

Infrastructure

Transformative infrastructure shapes better communities. From residential buildings and roads to bridges and culverts, Conart incorporates sustainable and green building solutions into every project.

About

CONART is one of India’s most experienced and acclaimed firms in building and civil construction, renowned for its dedication to project excellence. For more than four decades, we have turned our clients’ ideas and visions into award-winning projects.

Our unwavering commitment is to deliver every project beyond our clients’ expectations for safety, quality, functionality, and aesthetics—creating finished works that stand the test of time.

Read more

Expertise

Safety

Safety is at the heart of every project we undertake—driven not only by success metrics, but by a genuine concern for the well-being of every individual involved.

Delivery

Our foundational values and nearly fifty years of experience have naturally aligned us with modern Integrated Project Delivery (IPD), Lean Construction, and Design/Build practices.

Sustainability

We embrace sustainable building practices, not just as a trend, but because protecting the environment for future generations is fundamental—benefiting both our clients and the planet.

Self Perform

We choose to self-perform work only when it offers our clients significant advantages in cost, schedule, or quality.

Quality

Our ISO 9001-2015 certification, held for over a decade, reflects our unwavering dedication to quality—ensuring trust for our clients and consistency in every project.

Project Management

Our construction project management services are tailored to help owners control costs and schedules while ensuring high quality. We guide projects from pre-construction and design through completion and closeout. Our expert team brings award-winning experience and seamless transitions for projects in energy, infrastructure, commercial, and residential sectors.
 

Read more

Tradition of Excellence

With over four decades of industry leadership, Conart has earned its reputation as one of India’s most experienced and respected building and civil construction firms. We have consistently transformed our clients’ visions into award-winning projects by aiming not just to meet, but to exceed expectations for safety, quality, functionality, and aesthetics. Our projects are built to stand the test of time, reflecting our unwavering commitment to excellence in every detail.

A Team of Experts

Our experienced professionals manage projects of every size and complexity—from intricate renovations to major civil works—delivering reliable solutions every time.

Built With Care

Our commitment to constant improvement drives us to raise the standard in every aspect of our work.

Time Delivery

Our people set us apart—their passion, dedication, and service make Conart the preferred partner for clients, subcontractors, and suppliers alike.
